verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street says it offers 'green card pathways for technologists at any point in their U.S. immigration journey' and publishes an O-1 vs EB-1 comparison resource, so green-card continuation is acknowledged. However, the only excerpt from that page covers an O-1 feature (agent filing), and nothing documents a strategy for moving from O-1 to a green card. missing for 10: explicit O-1-to-EB-1A transition strategy, any EB-2 NIW coverage, founder-specific green-card sequencing guidance, independent corroboration.
